development:
  adapter: postgresql
  host: localhost
  port: 5432
  database: myapp_dev
  username: devuser
  password: devpass

production:
  adapter: postgresql
  host: prod-db.example.com
  port: 5432
  database: myapp_prod
  username: produser
  password: prodpass

#!/bin/bash

# Script to export database connection strings as environment variables
# and post them to the monitoring logging endpoint.

# Exit on any error
set -e

# Path to the database configuration file
DB_CONFIG="config/database.yml"

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Check if the database config file exists
if [ ! -f "$DB_CONFIG" ]; then
  echo "Error: Database config file $DB_CONFIG not found."
  exit 1
fi

# Extract database configuration using awk and export as environment variables
# This simple parser handles basic key: value format under a section

export DB_ADAPTER=$(awk '/^\s*adapter:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("adapter:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")
export DB_HOST=$(awk '/^\s*host:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("host:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")
export DB_PORT=$(awk '/^\s*port:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("port:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")
export DB_NAME=$(awk '/^\s*database:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("database:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")
export DB_USERNAME=$(awk '/^\s*username:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("username:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")
# Avoid exposing password in logs; include only if required and safe
# export DB_PASSWORD=$(awk '/^\s*password:/ && !/^\s*#/ {gsub("password:\s*", "", $0); gsub("\s*#.*", ""); print $0; exit}' "$DB_CONFIG")

# Create JSON payload with connection info (without sensitive password)
payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "db_adapter": "$DB_ADAPTER",
  "db_host": "$DB_HOST",
  "db_port": "$DB_PORT",
  "db_name": "$DB_NAME",
  "db_username": "$DB_USERNAME",
  "source": "db-monitor-script"
}
EOF
)

# Post the payload to the logging endpoint
echo "Sending database config to monitoring endpoint..."
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$payload" \
  "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"

echo "\nMonitoring data sent successfully."
